channels.name: SPDIF_TX (coax)
channels.purpose: Single-wire 75 Ω coaxial output carrying BMC-encoded IEC 60958 type II stream.
channels.active_levels: 0.5-0.6 V peak-to-peak at the transmitter; 0.2 V minimum at the receiver
channels.idle_level: Implementation-defined (often continuous BMC stream with audio = 0 and V = 1; otherwise driven LOW or HIGH)

channels.name: SPDIF_RX (coax)
channels.purpose: Single-wire 75 Ω coaxial input; the receiver-side counterpart of SPDIF_TX (in transceiver ICs, the same pin or its differential).
channels.active_levels: 0.2 V minimum input level; 75 Ω termination at the receiver

channels.name: SPDIF (Toslink Tx)
channels.purpose: Toslink (JIS F05 / EIAJ optical) LED driver carrying BMC-encoded IEC 60958 type II stream.
channels.active_levels: Optical ON / OFF; light pulses correspond to BMC cell levels
channels.idle_level: Implementation-defined (LED stays modulating with silence frames or turns off)

channels.name: SPDIF (Toslink Rx)
channels.purpose: Toslink optical receiver photodiode + comparator; converts optical pulses back to digital BMC stream.
channels.active_levels: Light pulses; receiver thresholds the photodiode output to recover the BMC signal

channel_counts.comment: S/PDIF is a single-wire (coax) or single-fibre (optical) self-clocked link. The bit clock is embedded in the BMC line code; no separate clock or chip-select pin exists.

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_audio_sample: LSB at bit 8, MSB at bit 27 of the subframe (audio is LSB-first within the 20-bit field).
ordering_rules.subframe_order_within_frame: Channel A (preamble X or Z) first, then channel B (preamble Y).
ordering_rules.frame_order_within_block: Frame 1 (Z preamble on channel A) → Frame 2 (X) → ... → Frame 192 (X); next block starts with Z again.
ordering_rules.channel_status_bit_order: Bit 0 of byte 0 is the FIRST C-bit emitted after the block boundary (Z); bit 7 of byte 23 is the LAST C-bit of the block.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Transmitter drives BMC-encoded subframes continuously. Each subframe carries Preamble + Aux + Audio + V + U + C + P, computed by the transmitter and verified by the receiver. The receiver recovers bit clock from BMC transitions and uses X / Y / Z preambles to align subframe / frame / block boundaries.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each subframe must end with a parity bit P that is even over bits 4-30; each block must start with a Z preamble; the 192-bit channel-status word is reassembled at every block boundary.

handshake_pairs.name: BMC_CLK_RECOVERY
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter inserts ≥ 1 transition per data-bit; receiver recovers the bit clock from these transitions.

handshake_pairs.name: PREAMBLE_ALIGN
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter emits one of X / Y / Z at every subframe start; receiver pattern-matches the long pulse to align subframe + frame + block counters.

handshake_pairs.name: PARITY_CHECK
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter sets P so that bits 4-30 + P have even parity; receiver verifies and reports.

handshake_pairs.name: VALIDITY_GATE
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter sets V = 1 to forbid PCM DAC consumption (e.g. for IEC 61937 mode or fault); receiver mutes its DAC and routes the audio-sample field accordingly.

handshake_pairs.name: CHANNEL_STATUS_ACCUM
handshake_pairs.rule: Transmitter emits 1 channel-status bit per subframe; receiver shifts them into a 192-bit channel-status accumulator per channel and re-parses on every block boundary.
